ideas.pitch: A real-time login anomaly detector that breaks down impossible travel, ASN anomalies, and device fingerprint shifts into human-readable risk reports.
ideas.title: AuthLogix: Explainable Risk Signals for Smart Login Guardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a published challenge area with reproducible log analysis and explainability, leveraging patterns from proven log-analysis winners.

ideas.pitch: An automated traffic analysis dashboard that ingests synthetic API request logs to instantly flag DDoS precursors, credential stuffing, and unusual traffic spikes.
ideas.title: LogSentry: NGINX and API Traffic Spike Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the exact focus on working prototypes and reproducible results using synthetic request metrics.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight parser and LLM wrapper that ingests raw, cryptic SIEM alerts and converts them into prioritized remediation playbooks for junior engineers.
ideas.title: AlertInterpreter: Structured Security Alert Plain-Language Converter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate utility for cybersecurity practitioners by turning noisy technical alerts into actionable advice.

ideas.pitch: A time-series anomaly detection pipeline that analyzes synthetic CPU, memory, and latency metrics to forecast system outages before thresholds are breached.
ideas.title: MetricPulse: Early Warning Outage Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust statistical metric tracking with a clear, functional dashboard matching the judges' priority on technical understanding.

ideas.pitch: An isolated diagnostic tool that combs through synthetic system measurement dumps to flag out-of-bounds metrics and structural anomalies.
ideas.title: AutoAudit: Automated System Health and Anomaly Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an isolated, easily demonstrable ingestion pipeline that proves technical rigor within a short 24-48 hour window.
